limitations: Developer workstation with other apps active, including production Monitor near one CPU. Before series overlapped builds/tests; after series did not. Fresh derivative catalogs with warm OS caches. First useful state is publication, not pixels or complete history. Pooled update quantiles within ten launches describe these observations; they do not establish stable tails. RSS sampled at 100 ms is a lower bound. Stage boundaries differ before/after; no direct wall-latency speedup ratio is asserted.
excluded_observations: Initial sandbox-restricted ps observation failed; not included.
Before large 18-second launches did not include prepared workflow inventory; replaced by ten 45-second launches.

interactive.limitations: Single perturbed session with UI automation and sampling, after automatic history loading. Excluded from launch comparison. Accessibility overhead is not app latency. Prolonged settled scroll observation inconclusive.
